description: Read, create, delete, and organize bookmarks in Pinboard.

auth.label: API Token
auth.description: Pinboard API token in username:TOKEN form, sent as the auth_token query parameter. Find it on the Pinboard password settings page: https://pinboard.in/settings/password

actions.name: add_bookmark
actions.description: Add or replace a Pinboard bookmark.

title.description: The bookmark title. Pinboard calls this field description.

description.description: The optional bookmark description or extended text.

items.description: A Pinboard tag. Tags may not contain commas or whitespace.

tags.description: Pinboard tags to match or attach. Multiple tags are joined with spaces for the upstream API.

createdAt.description: The bookmark creation time in UTC.

replace.description: Whether to replace an existing bookmark for the same URL.

shared.description: Whether to make the bookmark public.

toRead.description: Whether to mark the bookmark as unread.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for adding a Pinboard bookmark.

resultCode.description: The result code returned by Pinboard.

actions.name: delete_bookmark
actions.description: Delete a Pinboard bookmark by URL.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for deleting a Pinboard bookmark.

resultCode.description: The result code returned by Pinboard.

actions.name: get_bookmarks
actions.description: Get Pinboard bookmarks for a URL, date, or up to three tags using the posts/get endpoint.

url.description: Return the bookmark for this exact URL.

items.description: A Pinboard tag. Tags may not contain commas or whitespace.

tags.description: Up to three tags to filter by. Pinboard treats multiple tags as a combined tag filter.

date.description: Return bookmarks created on this UTC date.

includeMeta.description: Whether to include Pinboard change detection signatures.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for getting Pinboard bookmarks.

description.description: The optional bookmark description or extended text.

items.description: A Pinboard tag. Tags may not contain commas or whitespace.

createdAt.description: The bookmark creation time returned by Pinboard.

meta.description: The optional Pinboard change detection signature.

toRead.description: Whether the bookmark is marked as unread.

others.description: The number of other Pinboard users who saved the same URL.

bookmarks.description: The Pinboard bookmarks returned by the endpoint.

date.description: The Pinboard response date or timestamp for this list.

user.description: The Pinboard username associated with the response.

outputSchema.description: The wrapped Pinboard bookmark list output.

actions.name: get_last_update
actions.description: Get the most recent time a Pinboard bookmark was added, updated, or deleted.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for checking the Pinboard update timestamp.

updateTime.description: The most recent bookmark update time returned by Pinboard.

outputSchema.description: The wrapped Pinboard update timestamp output.

actions.name: list_recent_bookmarks
actions.description: List the user's most recent Pinboard bookmarks, optionally filtered by one tag.

count.description: The number of bookmarks to return. Pinboard allows up to 100.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing recent Pinboard bookmarks.

description.description: The optional bookmark description or extended text.

items.description: A Pinboard tag. Tags may not contain commas or whitespace.

createdAt.description: The bookmark creation time returned by Pinboard.

meta.description: The optional Pinboard change detection signature.

toRead.description: Whether the bookmark is marked as unread.

others.description: The number of other Pinboard users who saved the same URL.

bookmarks.description: The Pinboard bookmarks returned by the endpoint.

date.description: The Pinboard response date or timestamp for this list.

user.description: The Pinboard username associated with the response.

outputSchema.description: The wrapped Pinboard bookmark list output.

actions.name: list_tags
actions.description: List the user's Pinboard tags and bookmark counts.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for listing Pinboard tags.

tag.description: A Pinboard tag. Tags may not contain commas or whitespace.

count.description: The number of bookmarks using this tag.

items.description: A Pinboard tag and its bookmark count.

tags.description: The Pinboard tags returned by the account.

outputSchema.description: The wrapped Pinboard tag list output.
